description: Search PubMed with its own query syntax (AND / OR, field tags like [pt], [ti], [mesh]); sort relevance | newest; years "2020-2026". Faster and far smaller than asking PubMed: the total and up to 100 rows as arrays in columns order — PMID, title, first author, year, journal, publication types, PMCID when free full text exists, and the library level when the paper is already stored. The same search is answered from disk for 7 days. For a batch of PMIDs: library_pubmed_fetch_articles; for abstract or full text: library_read.

query.description: PubMed query, full syntax: "tadalafil AND (systematic review[pt] OR meta-analysis[pt])".

sort.description: relevance (PubMed's ranking) or newest (publication date, latest first).

name: library_pubmed_search_articles
